## AI Projector Remote
More than a remote · your AI projector concierge

# The last missing piece of your projector.

Where tedious typing flows at your fingertip. Remote, keyboard, touchpad, air mouse, voice and text — six control modes, one direct BLE link, one app.

[Download the app](https://luminago.app/#download) [See what it does](https://luminago.app/#features)

Why we built this

## Six moments Lumina Go is there to save.

Every feature in Lumina Go exists because someone got stuck. These are the scenarios that kept coming back — and what we built to solve them.

01

Scenario 01 — The remote is gone

### “The stick remote is missing. Again.”

Projector remotes seem engineered to fall between sofa cushions. Lose one and a powerful machine becomes a very expensive paperweight. Lumina Go drops a full BLE remote back into the phone you already carry everywhere.

- 4-way D-pad + center OK, the same keys as the original
- Power · Mute · Source · Cast · Brightness · Zoom · Volume
- Sub-20 ms BLE response at up to 10 m, no pairing ritual

![“The stick remote is missing. Again.”](https://luminago.app/screenshots/s1.png)

02

Scenario 02 — The app needs a cursor

### “This app is unusable with a D-pad.”

Browsers, casual games, store UIs — lots of apps quietly assume a cursor. Plugging a USB mouse into the projector is clumsy. Lumina Go gives you two cursor-grade options in one app: a precise touchpad, and a full-motion air mouse.

- Touchpad: slide-to-move + Left / Right Click, sensitivity up to 1.5×
- Air mouse: gyro + accelerometer fused on-device, sensitivity up to 3.0×
- One tap at the bottom to switch between the two

![“This app is unusable with a D-pad.” — touchpad](https://luminago.app/screenshots/s3.png)

![“This app is unusable with a D-pad.” — air mouse](https://luminago.app/screenshots/s4.png)

03

Scenario 03 — Typing is torture

### “Entering my Wi-Fi password shouldn't be a puzzle.”

Projectors ship with some of the worst on-screen keyboards in consumer electronics. A 16-character Wi-Fi key can take minutes, and one wrong hop means starting over. Lumina Go lays a full QWERTY on the device you already type on every day.

- Complete QWERTY with numbers and symbols one tap away
- Stays in sync with whatever text field the projector has focus on
- Enter, backspace, space — exactly where your thumbs expect them

![“Entering my Wi-Fi password shouldn't be a puzzle.”](https://luminago.app/screenshots/s2.png)

04

Scenario 04 — Just too long to type

### “Just paste the password. Just paste the URL.”

Some things shouldn't be typed letter by letter — 40-character Wi-Fi keys, a friend's share link, a foreign movie title. Write or paste on the phone, hit Send, and Lumina Go delivers it via clipboard paste on the projector in one go.

- Edit and review the text on the phone before sending it
- Great for URLs, search queries, long titles, Wi-Fi keys
- Pastes into whichever text field the projector currently focuses on

![“Just paste the password. Just paste the URL.”](https://luminago.app/screenshots/s6.png)

05

Scenario 05 — Your projector has no voice

Most loved

### “‘Search Transformers’ — if only.”

Modern TVs ship with voice assistants. Most projectors don't — or they do, but only inside the maker's own apps. Lumina Go turns your phone into the voice remote your projector never had, using your phone's world-class speech stack and 50+ projector intents parsed on-device.

- “Open Netflix” · “Volume up” · “Wi-Fi settings” · “Go home”
- Uses your phone's native speech recognition — no wake word needed
- Parsed locally — audio and transcripts never leave the phone

![“‘Search Transformers’ — if only.”](https://luminago.app/screenshots/s5.png)

06

Scenario 06 — Stuck on something

### “Why is my image green? How do I enter Bluetooth-speaker mode?”

Manuals are long. Forum answers are old. Lumina Go ships with an AI projector assistant, built on frontier LLMs (ChatGPT-class) layered with the last few years of our own projector engineering notes and troubleshooting playbooks. Tap the ? on any screen and ask in any language.

- Answers are aware of the exact projector model and firmware you have
- Trained on our own troubleshooting playbooks and user-manual content
- Chats in English, 中文, 日本語, Español

AI Projector Assistant

ChatGPT-class · model-aware

online

Why is my image coming out green?

Sounds like an RGB channel misalignment. On your projector, open Settings → Color → Reset. If it persists, try a different HDMI cable — worn-out cables drop the red channel first.

How do I enter Bluetooth-speaker mode?

Ask anything about your projector…

07

Scenario 07 — Movie night, blinding phone

### “It's 1 AM. Why is my phone a flashlight?”

You dim the lights, queue the movie, grab the phone to tweak the volume — and a pure-white UI blasts your eyes back open. Most remote apps never thought about this. Lumina Go ships with two hand-tuned themes: a crisp daytime palette, and a cinema-friendly night theme that auto-follows your phone's system appearance.

- Auto day / night — follows iOS & Android system appearance, or override by hand
- Every screen designed twice — Remote, Keyboard, Touchpad, Air mouse, Voice, Text
- OLED-friendly true blacks at night, high-contrast readability by day

![Remote page, Day theme](https://luminago.app/screenshots/s1-light.png)

Day

![Remote page, Night theme](https://luminago.app/screenshots/s1.png)

Night

What's next

### We're just getting started.

Every scenario above came from a real user who got stuck. If there's still a moment we haven't covered — or something that isn't working for you — tell us. You'll see it in the next release.
